subject.title: feat: add readiness conditions and hosting profiles

question: Should OpenClaw extend its existing readiness contract with all four hosting profiles, operator-composed profiles, and the public plugin readiness callback API?
rationale: Implementation quality and strong Docker proof cannot decide permanent availability policy, three operator-selection surfaces, new response fields, and an executable external plugin contract while the dedicated RFC remains open.

options.title: Approve a narrower first release
options.body: Add canonical readiness projection and `openclaw ready` first, deferring hosting profiles and plugin callbacks to separately approved follow-ups.

options.title: Approve the full contract
options.body: Retain all proposed surfaces after both defects, conflicts, upgrade evidence, and compatibility documentation are resolved.

options.title: Pause pending RFC
options.body: Keep the draft open without further landing work until maintainers decide the permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrower first release
recommendation.body: Add canonical readiness projection and `openclaw ready` first, deferring hosting profiles and plugin callbacks to separately approved follow-ups.
